gen-gf-underdog-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk comes across lively and tall in the lowercase, its bowls left unfinished on one side so the letters feel quick. Underdog's hairline-free display forms sit above it with a louder voice.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-hind: Underdog opens with a horseshoe-shaped c and no weight shift along any curve, loud and unmistakable. Hind follows in a plain sans, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its strokes as steady as a drawn string.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-nunito: Approachable is the first word for Nunito, with big round bowls and terminals that stop short of the stem. Its generous lowercase gives Underdog's hollow, glass-tube lettering a friendlier, lower-set partner that feels easy to settle into.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Underdog's horseshoe c is the giveaway, a display face whose curves never change weight as they bend. And Pilcrow Rounded, a warm sans with big counters and tight spacing, can be sized up a touch so those open curves breathe.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-quicksand: Approachable describes Quicksand, whose tall lowercase bowls look like blown glass bulbs. Underdog earns its keep in big, short lines, where its horseshoe c and weight-steady curves get room to be loud.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-actor: Actor reads clean and modern, its wide s curves barely curling in. Underdog brings a pen-like t with crossbar and stem sharing one width, so the page moves from loud display lettering to quiet, tidy text.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-akatab: Underdog brings an expressive, pen-like line of constant weight, with a horseshoe c that opens wide and refuses to shift thickness. Akatab does the quieter job in a plain sans, its round letters cupped rather than clenched.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-alan-sans: Underdog's single most telling habit is a line that never swells or thins, even around the horseshoe c. Alan Sans keeps the tails of its curves held back, doing the modern, professional work of text while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes, with a stroke thickness that ignores direction. Albert Sans sits under Underdog's expressive display letters, giving a sans-serif text voice that lets the heading's wide horseshoe c stay the showpiece.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Alegreya Sans SC reads contemporary and modern, with an open, welcoming gap in the c. And Underdog's identical bar thickness across the line gives that quiet text a bold, expressive head, which is the pair's best trick.
